# Model-Round Run Record｜模型轮运行记录

## Scope｜范围

This is a minimal, redacted package copy of one preserved M01 prompt condition set, three candidates, and three determinations. It is a desktop record, not a field test. The exact service identity and seed are unavailable.

这是一个已保留 M01 题面条件、三个候选和三个裁决的最小脱敏随包副本。它是桌面记录，不是现场测试；精确服务身份与种子不可得。

## Preserved prompt conditions｜保留的题面条件

| Topic｜主题 | Condition｜条件 |
|---|---|
| Object｜对象 | A withdrawable ground-floor–kerb–park interface candidate at Dazhongsi; exact location and dimensions remain UNKNOWN.｜大钟寺首层—路缘—公园接口的可撤候选；精确点位与尺寸保持 UNKNOWN。 |
| Everyday task｜日常任务 | Serve replenishment, short stops, continuous passage, and quiet conditions for couriers, merchants, residents, and pedestrians.｜服务骑手、商户、居民和行人的补货、短停、连续通行与安静任务。 |
| Non-AI baseline｜非 AI 基线 | Fixed loading windows, static parking spaces, and human guidance.｜固定装卸时段、静态车位和人工引导。 |
| Data limit｜数据限制 | Only future authorized aggregate counts may compare options; no tracking, profiling, or evaluation of individual couriers.｜只有未来获授权的聚合计数可用于比较；不跟踪、画像或考核个人骑手。 |
| Unknowns｜未知项 | Road rights, fire safety, accessibility, loading, site, data, operating responsibility, retest date, and restoration cost.｜路权、消防、无障碍、装卸、场地、数据、运营责任、复测日和恢复费用。 |
| Stop conditions｜停止条件 | Responsibility is unassigned; hazards rise; fire safety or accessibility is obstructed; the slowest group worsens; or human takeover fails.｜责任未接、险情上升、消防或无障碍受阻、最慢群体变差，或人工接手失败。 |
| Restoration｜恢复 | Remove the change, restore the prior state and non-AI timetable, then let real users repeat the route.｜撤除改变，恢复原状与非 AI 时刻表，再由真实使用者复走。 |
| Status｜状态 | Not approved · Not authorized · Not tested · Non-field.｜未批准 · 未授权 · 未测试 · 非现场。 |

## Three preserved candidates｜三个已保留候选

| Candidate｜候选 | Spatial idea and requested action｜空间想法与请求动作 | Non-AI and data boundary｜非 AI 与数据边界 | Stop and restoration｜停止与恢复 | Advancement claim｜推进声称 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| M01-A | A time-sliced kerb using removable markings, movable notices, and human presence; compare only the paper arrangement.｜以可撤标线、移动告示和人工值守组织分时路缘；只比较纸面排布。 | Fixed windows, static parking, human guidance; future aggregate counts only; no personal tracking.｜保留固定时段、静态车位和人工引导；未来只用聚合计数；不追踪个人。 | Remove notices and markings, restore the prior state and non-AI timetable, then repeat the route.｜撤下告示与标线，恢复原状和非 AI 时刻表，再复走。 | No claim of first use, procurement, construction, or operations.｜不声称进入首用、采购、建设或运营。 |
| M01-B | A withdrawable comparison island that places human guidance, static parking, and a removable observation interface together; prepare only a desktop layout and removal order.｜把人工引导、静态车位和可撤观察界面并置；只制作桌面布局与撤除顺序。 | Human guidance, fixed windows, and static parking remain; future comparison is anonymous and aggregated.｜保留人工引导、固定时段和静态车位；未来比较仅匿名聚合。 | Remove the observation interface, restore the prior state, non-AI timetable, and human guidance, then repeat the route.｜撤除观察界面，恢复原状、非 AI 时刻表与人工引导，再复走。 | No claim that any real admission condition has been met.｜不声称已通过任何现实准入条件。 |
| M01-C | A turn-back buffer that sequences replenishment waiting, continuous passage, quiet frontage, and a human takeover point; test conflicts first on a paper timetable.｜按顺序组织补货等待、连续通道、安静界面和人工接手点；先用纸面时刻表检查冲突。 | No field data; fixed windows, static parking, paper timetable, and human takeover remain independently usable.｜不使用现场数据；固定时段、静态车位、纸面时刻表和人工接手可独立运行。 | If responsibility is unassigned or human takeover fails, stop advancement and restore the prior state and non-AI arrangement; no repeat walk has occurred.｜责任未接或人工接手失败即停，恢复原状和非 AI 安排；尚未复走。 | Remains a desktop candidate and does not enter field use, approval, construction, or operations.｜保持桌面候选，不进入现场、批准、建设或运营。 |

## Three determinations｜三个裁决

| Candidate｜候选 | Data / problem / protocol｜数据／问题／协议 | First use｜城市首用 | Projects and funding｜项目与资金 | Construction and operations｜建设运营 | Overall｜总判定 | Field｜现场 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M01-A | Consistent｜一致 | Condition unmet｜条件未满足 | Condition unmet｜条件未满足 | Condition unmet｜条件未满足 | Held｜停住 | No｜否 |
| M01-B | Consistent｜一致 | Condition unmet｜条件未满足 | Condition unmet｜条件未满足 | Condition unmet｜条件未满足 | Held｜停住 | No｜否 |
| M01-C | Consistent｜一致 | Condition unmet｜条件未满足 | Condition unmet｜条件未满足 | Condition unmet｜条件未满足 | Held｜停住 | No｜否 |

The archived source labels this as one preregistered round without outcome-based selection and says that no candidate was deleted. This package copy shows one condition set, three candidates, and three determinations, but cannot independently prove that no other run was omitted.

留档来源把它标为一轮预先登记、非按结果挑选，并写明未删除候选。包内只能核到这一份条件、三个候选和三个裁决，不能独立证明没有其他未留存轮次。
verification_boundary: Minimal redacted desktop record only; not field evidence, approval, authorization, implementation, or independently rerunnable code.
